fields.subject: Expression Debug View
fields.trigger: the renderer emits a parenthesized, bracketed, braced, or angle-bracketed list of sub-expressions or parameter declarations
fields.response: open with the list's delimiter character, lay out a braced list or any list with more than one element with each element on its own indented line separated by the list's separator character (a comma by default), keep a single-element non-braced list on one line, close with the delimiter's matching character (`)` for `(`, `}` for `{`, `]` for `[`, `>` for `<`), and for a parameter-declaration list additionally render each declared variable's type, an `&` suffix when it is by-reference, and then the variable's own parameter rendering
fields.postcondition: every delimiter the renderer opens for the list is closed with its complementary character
